Presenting BOL MERE SATHIYA KITNA MUJHSE PYAR HAI FULL VIDEO SONG from LALKAR movie starring Dharmendra, Rajendra Kumar, Mala Sinha, Kumkum, Nazir Hussain in lead roles, released in 1972. The song is sung by Lata Mangeshkar, Mohammed Rafi and music is given by Kalyanji-Anandji, music is available exclusively on Gaane Sune Ansune.
Song: BOL MERE SATHIYA KITNA MUJHSE PYAR HAI
Singer: LATA MANGESHKAR, MOHAMMED RAFI
Music Director: KALYANJI-ANANDJI
Lyricist: HASRAT JAIPURI
